top_signals.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
top_signals.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nvidia's investments grow to $99 billion as chip giant becomes major backer of AI companies
top_signals.summary: Nvidia reported $99 billion in equity holdings as it backs AI labs, cloud providers and infrastructure companies across the sector.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: West Ham Takeover Saga Sees Sullivan and Kretinsky Raise Stakes
top_signals.summary: The battle for control of West Ham United took another twist as a former chairman who faces allegations of historical sex abuse increased his stake in the London football club while Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky became the biggest shareholder.
